data.body: **P2:** Deferring visible non-local samplers makes distinct executions collide in `DurableSampler`'s trace-ID-only cache. When two execution ARNs receive the same root-only propagated trace, the second reuses the first execution's `SamplingResult`, including ARN-dependent decisions, attributes, and trace state, despite having a distinct synthetic root. Carry a stable execution key (ARN or generated root span ID) separately from the canonical trace ID, cache by that key while passing the trace ID to the delegate, and test two ARNs sharing one trace against a single foreign provider.
